Evelyn — forwarding for a quick fraud gating check. BrightWave asked for another $5k in credits; they supplied the usage CSV (attached). On the face of it this looks like a heavy but plausible pilot. However I pulled their account history and see two prior trial top-ups in the last 4 months under slightly different emails (we have prior-promo-history.pdf attached). Can you confirm whether this pattern meets our abuse signals? If so, recommend next steps — deny, conditional approval, or move to procurement for a paid POC.

I need a decision by EOD Friday 3/5 so I can respond to Alex before their test start.

Thanks,
Neha

Attachment: credit-usage-report.csv (generated by Neha - attachment stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Quick favor — additional trial credits for POC

Neha / team — I ran the account checks and flagged notes:
- We found two prior trial credit grants (2025-11-10 and 2026-01-14) to accounts with matching company name but different emails.
- Token consumption profiles match automated ingestion scripts (consistent high throughput, same IP ranges across events).
- Payment/identity signals: no verified corporate billing method on file.
- Prior red flags: sales notes from 2025-11 mention "stressed usage during ingest; requested immediate top-up" which is a recurring pattern.

Recommendation: put a temporary hold on additional free credits. Offer a paid POC (30% discount for a committed $15k purchase) and require a single signed SOW or PO. If Sales wants to proceed with a credit exception, require Security/Compliance sign-off with an audit trail (we will need domain-verified contact and a billing method).

I can prepare a short memo for legal/finance if you want to escalate. Given the repeated top-ups, this looks like potential promo abuse rather than a genuine single-account pilot.

—Evelyn Hart
Senior Security & Compliance Analyst | Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Team — I agree with Evelyn's conservative approach. Please do NOT grant another free credit top-up. Neha, tell BrightWave: we can pause the credit extension but provide a short-term paid POC at a reduced rate (as Evelyn suggested) so they can complete their tests without delay. If they provide a verified corporate PO and billing, we fast-track onboarding.

Dev — prep a technical scope for the paid POC offer (what $15k covers in throughput/SLOs). Evelyn — please draft the memo to finance/legal so we have a record if they push back. Neha, I leave the customer-facing wording to you — keep it firm but helpful.
